cond_0001.intro:
The Transportation Analyst is responsible for supporting 3pl clients, Warehouse Operations, Customer Operations, New Business Implementations, and the CRM team with all aspects of transportation. The Analyst are responsible for managing the relationship with Transportation Providers. The role supports internal processes including MTK Management, POD Process, Yard management for campus transfers and Retail Routing Guide management. Additionally the analyst must be experienced in carrier selection, transportation rates, and routing. Responsibilities include responding to 3pl clients regarding transportation needs or concerns. Must be able to work with motor carriers to expedite shipments, address delivery and OS&D issues.
The Transportation Analyst is accountable for the management of all inbound and outbound analysis. This job is responsible for the timely communication of all carrier and transportation updates to the Operations teams. This job provides analytical support for all Transportation management functions to ensure cost control, service levels, information flow, as well as enforce compliance. The Transportation Analyst assists with the development of transportation initiatives as an integral part of the Operations team.

The Transportation Analyst is responsible for supporting 3pl clients, Warehouse Operations, Customer Operations, New Business Implementations, and the CRM team with all aspects of transportation. The Analyst are responsible for managing the relationship with Transportation Providers. The role supports internal processes including MTK Management, POD Process, Yard management for campus transfers and Retail Routing Guide management. Additionally the analyst must be experienced in carrier selection, transportation rates, and routing. Responsibilities include responding to 3pl clients regarding transportation needs or concerns. Must be able to work with motor carriers to expedite shipments, address delivery and OS&D issues.
We are looking for an experienced Transportation Analyst who has a positive, collaborative mindset and the ability to thrive in a dynamic environment. This position reports to Supervisor, Transportation Analyst.
The Transportation Analyst is accountable for the management of all inbound and outbound analysis. This job is responsible for the timely communication of all carrier and transportation updates to the Operations teams. This job provides analytical support for all Transportation management functions to ensure cost control, service levels, information flow, as well as enforce compliance. The Transportation Analyst assists with the development of transportation initiatives as an integral part of the Operations team.
cond_0012.responsibilities:
Analyzes transportation costs, negotiates carrier rates and determines service levels and compiles carrier outbound and inbound summary reporting.
Collaborates and leads quarterly business review process with carrier partners.
Prepares month end inbound and outbound accruals relative to freight plan and provides financial reporting to leadership.
Manage transportation of products for 3PL clients.
Analyzes regional activities and interprets operation results to develop solutions to help drive profitability and growth.
Works with regional leadership to provide guidance as necessary to optimize transportation systems, methods, procedures and costs.
Partners with our national customer care team to determine root causes of service level defects and works with the broader organization to provide customer focused transportation solutions.
Maintains department KPI's and measure for continuous improvements.
Multi-task with phone calls, emails and interoffice communication tools.
cond_0012.requirements:
Around 2–4 years of experience in a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Office.
Ability to communicate effectively, with solid interpersonal and presentation skills and attention to detail.
Experience with [Product name masked] or a compatible system.
Familiarity with database tools including Access and Excel; comfort with advanced PC skills.
Background in self-service analytics tools such as SQL and data visualization tools such as Tableau — willingness to continue developing these skills is welcome.
Some customer service experience.

cond_0189.intro:
We are looking for a Transportation Analyst to join our team.
The Transportation Analyst works with 3PL clients, Warehouse Operations, Customer Operations, New Business Implementations, and the CRM team on all aspects of transportation. The role involves coordinating relationships with Transportation Providers and supporting internal processes including MTK Management, POD Process, Yard management for campus transfers, and Retail Routing Guide management. The analyst works alongside the team on carrier selection, transportation rates, and routing, and coordinates with motor carriers to expedite shipments and address delivery and OS&D issues.

We are looking for a Transportation Analyst to join our team.
The Transportation Analyst is accountable for the management of all inbound and outbound analysis. This role is responsible for the timely communication of all carrier and transportation updates to the Operations teams. This role provides analytical support for all Transportation management functions to help ensure cost control, service levels, and information flow, as well as enforce compliance. The Transportation Analyst works alongside the Operations team to support the development of transportation initiatives.
cond_0648.responsibilities:
Coordinate with internal teams to analyze transportation costs, negotiate carrier rates, and align on service levels; compile carrier outbound and inbound summary reporting.
Collaborate with carrier partners on the quarterly business review process.
Prepare month end inbound and outbound accruals relative to freight plan and share financial reporting with leadership.
Work with 3PL clients to support transportation needs for their products.
Analyze regional activities and interpret operation results, working with others to develop solutions that support profitability and growth.
Partner with regional leadership to provide guidance on optimizing transportation systems, methods, procedures, and costs.
Coordinate with the national customer care team to identify root causes of service level defects and help develop customer-focused transportation solutions.
Maintain department KPIs and support continuous improvement efforts.
Respond to inquiries and coordinate across phone, email, and interoffice communication tools.
